observed: The lower edge of the coat hides the knee. Boots alternate under the hem. On snow, a dark trailing boot reads clearly against the snow, separating from beneath the coat during push-off. The nearest white-cuffed blue sleeve occasionally hides the forward foot. The registration to the saved owner frames differs by about half a second.
Player moving through north gate at a diagonal, slowing at floor mat. Projected boots separate below coat, lower knee is often hidden.
Delivery worker turns to the fish stand then back from it. The front and side views show alternating boots beneath jacket; the standing player in blue is a separate actor.
